name: my-little-mods
description: ✨ Little side-pane mods that show what Claude is doing, in three styles: ⚔️ RPG, 🍃 Calm and 🌼 Day

plugins.name: rpg
plugins.description: ⚔️ RPG — A pixel-art camp: your hero acts out what Claude is doing, levels up as you work, and finds a glowing treasure chest when a quest is done. Open with /log-rpg.

plugins.name: calm
plugins.description: 🍃 Calm — A quiet dashboard: thin rings for your usage limits, serif titles, and one soft accent color you pick. Open with /log-calm.

plugins.name: day
plugins.description: 🌼 Day — A warm journal: a card wearing the sky of the hour, pastel limit cards and pill charts, and a hello by name. Open with /log-day.
